description.from: GitBouncer (formerly Pudicus) is a practical shift-left security illustration intended for donation to Data Parade alongside BotSpy. Codex owns the current scanner hardening, README/branding migration, and tracker reconciliation; other agents should check assignment and coordination claims before editing these records. Local Gitleaks integration and synthetic regression evidence are complete. Product publication and cross-project adoption remain pending. User selected GitBouncer and authorized transfer, but external rename/transfer is paused pending resolution of the existing achrafash/gitbouncer Git/privacy branding overlap. DataParade-io is verified through BotSpy ownership and authenticated permissions. No repository, access, deployment or package publication change has occurred. Preserve compatibility with existing Pudicus hooks, commands, configuration, and receipts.
